cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll return your spare key after dinner. Have you booked somewhere?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I never gave you a spare key. Where did you get it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Let's get a table before everywhere fills up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked. Did my sister give you that key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For two or three? We can't leave your sister without dinner.

mechanism: A uses control of dinner arrangements to defer the one question about unauthorized key access.
confusable: Unlike changing topics randomly, every diversion takes a detail from B's key question into dinner logistics.
comparison: A sister named as possible key source becomes a guest, unlike diverting a photo identity into gift shopping.
seedUse: The seed's booking urgency and guest-count redirection already give the decision-taking Stance concrete control of the topic.
